{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = trial_df.isnull().sum()

# Check data types and summary statistics
summary_stats = trial_df.describe(include='all')

# Check unique values in the 'disease_severity' column
disease_severity_counts = trial_df['disease_severity'].value_counts()

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = trial_df.duplicated().sum()

missing_values, disease_severity_counts, duplicates, summary_stats"}
